sessions.title: First visit
turns: Hi, I'm Alice. Can you help me find a place for dinner on Friday?
Of course. To pick well: any dietary needs, and which city?
I'm vegetarian and allergic to peanuts. I live in Berlin, Prenzlauer Berg. And please keep answers short, I read these on my phone.
Got it: vegetarian, peanut allergy, Berlin, short answers. How many people on Friday?
Four of us, around 8pm, somewhere in Mitte.
I'll shortlist vegetarian-friendly places in Mitte for four at 8pm and send them over.

sessions.title: Trip to Lisbon
turns: I want to book a trip to Lisbon, October 15 to 18, for me and my sister.
Lisbon, Oct 15–18, two travellers. Flights from Berlin? Any seat preference?
Yes from Berlin. Window seat for me. My sister is gluten-free, so restaurant suggestions need to work for her too. Hotel budget is 150 euros a night max.
Noted: window seat, sister is gluten-free, hotel under €150/night. I'll hold two options for each and come back.
Perfect. Also I pay with my Visa ending 4421, keep it on file for bookings.
Saved for bookings. I'll confirm the Lisbon options within the hour.

sessions.title: Changes before the trip
turns: Quick update: I moved to Hamburg last week, so flights should leave from Hamburg now, not Berlin.
Updated: you're in Hamburg now, flights from Hamburg. The Lisbon dates stay Oct 15–18?
Yes same dates. And I've changed my mind on seats, aisle is better for me now.
Aisle seat from now on. Anything else before I rebook the flights?

returning.question: Hey, what did I book with you, and did you remember my sister's thing?

forget.request: Please forget where I live, I don't want that stored.
